trans-unit.target: The enemy won't stand for this. That should give us a chance.

trans-unit.source: とりあえず、カメラは|つぶしておかないと
trans-unit.target: First and foremost, I'd better destroy this camera.

trans-unit.source: これで少しの間|敵の目をくらませられる。
trans-unit.target: This should blind the enemy for some time.

trans-unit.source: カメラを壊されては|敵も黙ってはいないはず。|急がなければ…
trans-unit.target: The enemy will notice the break in their surveillance soon. I need to hurry…

trans-unit.source: 今は少しでも敵の目を|ごまかさなければ…
trans-unit.target: I have to confuse the enemy any way I can for now...#ish

trans-unit.source: 他人のふりするなんて|悪い趣味だけど仕方ないわ。
trans-unit.target: Pretending to be someone else feels… tasteless, but there's no way around it.

trans-unit.source: これなら、きっと|捜査網を突破できる。
trans-unit.target: I'm sure I'll be able to break through the investigators' net with this.

trans-unit.source: これを仕掛ければ誰かが|犠牲になるかも…でも…
trans-unit.target: If I use this then someone might be sacrificed. But…

trans-unit.source: １人でも仕留められれば|敵の動きに影響するはず…
trans-unit.target: If I can bring down just one of them then it should affect their movements…

trans-unit.source: これも新世界のため…|敵は排除しなければ|いけないのよ。
trans-unit.target: This is for the sake of the new world, too…|We have no choice but to eliminate its enemies.

trans-unit.source: トラップで犠牲が！|…仕方ないわ…諦めて！
trans-unit.target: Someone got caught in my trap! ...I've got no choice... Give it up!

trans-unit.source: キラの邪魔をするからよ…|私のせいじゃない…
trans-unit.target: …It’s because they were trying to stop Kira…|It’s not my fault…

trans-unit.source: これなら月くんの望む|新世界創造も遠くない。
trans-unit.target: The new world Light hopes to create isn't so far away now.

trans-unit.source: いいわ…|ここまでは順調ね。
trans-unit.target: Good... Going well so far!

trans-unit.source: これでいい…慎重にやれば|必ずうまくいくはず。
trans-unit.target: We can work with this... If we move carefully then it's sure to turn out alright.

trans-unit.source: …やられた…どうすれば…
trans-unit.target: ...They got us... What do we do…

trans-unit.source: 敵に乗せられた？|でもまだ何か方法が…
trans-unit.target: The enemy got one over on us? But there has to still be a way…

trans-unit.source: 焦っちゃだめよ。慎重に|敵の動きを読まなければ…
trans-unit.target: Don't get hasty. You've got to think carefully about what the enemy are going to do next…

trans-unit.source: しまった…
trans-unit.target: Shit…

trans-unit.source: くっ…そんな…これじゃ…
trans-unit.target: Ugh... No... Not like this…

trans-unit.source: …これは私の失敗ね。
trans-unit.target: …This is my defeat, isn't it?

trans-unit.source: 検問ですって？|ムダな事を…
trans-unit.target: A roadblock? Wasting our time…

trans-unit.source: 予想はしていたけど、|ちょっとやっかいね。
trans-unit.target: We'd seen this coming but it's still kind of annoying, huh.

trans-unit.source: これは少し注意しないと、|動きを封じられるかも…
trans-unit.target: We might get blocked in if we don't move carefully…

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラ…|そこまでするなんて…
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera…|To think they’d go that far…

trans-unit.source: こんな手段まで使って…|こちらも油断できないわ。
trans-unit.target: To think they would go as far as to use this method… We cannot afford to let our guard down.

trans-unit.source: 放置しておくのは|危険だけど…どうするか…
trans-unit.target: It's dangerous to leave this as-is... What should I do…

trans-unit.source: やった！|これならいける！
trans-unit.target: Yay! Now we can keep going!

trans-unit.source: 少し遅れたかしら。|でも、問題はないはず…
trans-unit.target: I think I'm running a bit behind. Not that it should be a problem…

trans-unit.source: うまくいったわ。|後は予定通りにお願い。
trans-unit.target: That went perfectly! Now just do as we planned, alright?

trans-unit.source: 勝った！…月くん…|これでいいのね。
trans-unit.target: We won! ...Light... This is what you wanted, right?

trans-unit.source: 月くん…私達の新世界は|もうすぐ実現するわね？
trans-unit.target: Light… Our new world is almost here, isn't it?

trans-unit.source: やった！ 私達の勝ちよ。
trans-unit.target: Yay! We won!

trans-unit.source: そんな…これじゃ…|…私達…もう終わりなの？
trans-unit.target: No...! Then... Are we finished?

trans-unit.source: しまった…|…これは私の失敗ね。
trans-unit.target: Darn... This is my defeat, isn't it...

trans-unit.source: ちっ！ 月くんの役に|立てなかったというの…
trans-unit.target: Tch! How could I have been no use to Light…

trans-unit.source: 月くんがキラだったなんて|本当に驚いたわ。
trans-unit.target: It really was a shock to learn that Light was Kira.

trans-unit.source: あの弥さんって…|いちいちカンにさわるわね。
trans-unit.target: That Miss Amane…|She always makes me lose my temper.

trans-unit.source: 月くんと本当のパートナー|になれるのはこの私だけ…
trans-unit.target: I’m the only person good enough to be Light’s true partner…

trans-unit.source: キラを支持してきて|よかったわ。
trans-unit.target: It's a good thing I've always supported Kira.

trans-unit.source: 私なら必ず月くんの|役に立てるわ。
trans-unit.target: I'm going make absolutely sure I'm useful to Light.

trans-unit.source: 月くんはいつまで|弥さんのような低レベルの|女をそばに置くのかしら？
trans-unit.target: Such a low-level woman as Miss Amane… For how long will Light keep her by his side?

trans-unit.source: 私は負けない。|容姿も知性も、絶対に|弥さんに負けるはずがない。
trans-unit.target: I will not lose.|In both appearance and intelligence, it should be impossible for me to lose to Miss Amane.

trans-unit.source: 月くんのめざす新世界は|理想そのもの。|その力になれるなら|私は何でもするわ。
trans-unit.target: The new world Light aims for is the most ideal possible.|I'd do anything to help him create it.

trans-unit.source: ノートがこちらにある限り|うまく利用させてもらう。
trans-unit.target: I’ll make good use of the Death Note while it’s still with me.

trans-unit.source: ノートはおまえが|持っていろ。|これも作戦のうちだ。
trans-unit.target: You, take the Note. This is still part of the plan.

trans-unit.source: 少しは動きやすくなった|というところか。
trans-unit.target: Looks like we can move around a bit easier now.

trans-unit.source: こんなものに手間取るとは|予定外だ。
trans-unit.target: I didn’t think something like this would take so much effort.

trans-unit.source: まだ、これからだ。|いずれこの行動が役に立つ。
trans-unit.target: We're still in with a chance. This move will pay off sooner or later.

trans-unit.source: こんな手を使うとは、|やるじゃないか。
trans-unit.target: Using this kind of tactic… that’s pretty brave.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラか。だが甘いな。
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera, huh. But not hidden well enough.

trans-unit.source: 子供だましだが、|敵は混乱するだろう。
trans-unit.target: It's childish, but this'll confuse the enemy.

trans-unit.source: とりあえずこれで|顔を見られる事はない。
trans-unit.target: No one will be able to see my face for now.

trans-unit.source: これはあくまで保険だ。|だが、奴等には脅威のはず…
trans-unit.target: This is just insurance.|But it should be a threat for them…

trans-unit.source: フフ…奴等にもっと|ダメージを与えてやれ。
trans-unit.target: Hehe... Give 'em hell.

trans-unit.source: さあ、これからが|ショウタイムの本番だ。
trans-unit.target: Now here's where the real show starts.

trans-unit.source: ここまでは、|順調というところか。
trans-unit.target: Going well so far...

trans-unit.source: ちっ…このままじゃ…|何もかも終わりだ。
trans-unit.target: Tch... If things keep going like this, then we'll be done for.

trans-unit.source: 予想した以上にやるな…
trans-unit.target: They're being even more of a problem than we predicted…

trans-unit.source: くそッ！ 奴等には勝つ！|どんな手を使ってでも！
trans-unit.target: Shit, we can't let them win! Do whatever you have to but stop them!

trans-unit.source: ふん、まあいい。|まだ、どうとでもなる。
trans-unit.target: Hmph. Eh, whatever.|Everything's still going fine…

trans-unit.source: くっ……俺は…俺の力は|この程度だったのか？
trans-unit.target: Ugh... Is this...as much as I can do?

trans-unit.source: バカめ…予想ずみだ。
trans-unit.target: Idiots... We predicted this.

trans-unit.source: こちらを囲い込む|つもりか…なめるな！
trans-unit.target: They're trying to surround us, huh... Don't get cocky!

trans-unit.source: ルートを少し変更すれば|いいだけだ。問題ない。
trans-unit.target: I can just change my route. No problem.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラ…|奴等、何を企んで…？
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera... What are they planning...?

trans-unit.source: こいつを処理しないと|うかつには動けないか。
trans-unit.target: I need to move carefully unless I deal with this first.

trans-unit.source: カメラか。|顔を見られてはまずい。
trans-unit.target: A camera?|I can't let them see my face…

trans-unit.source: よくやった。|いいぞ、その調子だ。
trans-unit.target: Nice work. Keep it up!

trans-unit.source: 計画より遅れたな。|だが、まあいいだろう。
trans-unit.target: We're behind schedule, huh. But it'll probably be alright.

trans-unit.source: よし、次の計画を実行だ。
trans-unit.target: Good, carry out the next part of the plan.

trans-unit.source: ははっ！|どうだ。マヌケども！
trans-unit.target: Haha! How do you like that, you idiots?

trans-unit.source: フフフ… 俺の勝ちだな。
trans-unit.target: Hehehe... I win.

trans-unit.source: 俺こそがＬの後継者だ！
trans-unit.target: I am L's true successor!

trans-unit.source: まさか…あり得ない。|俺が負けるなんて！
trans-unit.target: No...that's not possible! I can't lose!

trans-unit.source: ちっ！ やられたか！|だが、次こそは！
trans-unit.target: Damn, did they get us? We'll be the ones who come out on top next time!

trans-unit.source: デスノート。|利用価値は高いが…
trans-unit.target: The Death Note. It's useful, but…

trans-unit.source: キラを倒すのは、この俺だ。
trans-unit.target: The one who topples Kira in the end… will be me.

trans-unit.source: 俺は必ず|Ｌの後継者になってみせる！
trans-unit.target: No matter what, I will become L's successor!

trans-unit.source: ニアの奴…|必ず出し抜いてやる。
trans-unit.target: That Near…|I'll definitely outsmart him.

trans-unit.source: キラめ…何を考えている。
trans-unit.target: That bastard Kira… What are they thinking?

trans-unit.source: 俺がＬを超えるには、|どうしても…
trans-unit.target: I'll do anything to surpass L…

trans-unit.source: キラは本当に神になる|つもりなのか…
trans-unit.target: Does Kira really intend to become a god…?

trans-unit.source: …ロジャー…俺はこんな|やり方しかできないんだ…
trans-unit.target: …Roger… There was no other way. You see that, right…?

trans-unit.source: ここはとりあえず、|そっちにノートを渡す。|あとは任せるぜ。
trans-unit.target: I’m passing the Death Note onto you for now.|I’ll leave the rest to ya.

trans-unit.source: このノート、|うまく使わなきゃ損だ。|頼んだぞ。
trans-unit.target: You’d better use this notebook well.|I’m counting on ya.

trans-unit.source: これでいい。つまらん手間、|取らせやがって。
trans-unit.target: Alright, we’re good. Ugh, setting that up was such a drag.

trans-unit.source: 目玉をつぶされりゃ、|奴等もしばらく動けまい。
trans-unit.target: If I smash their “eyes” in, those guys won’t be able to make their next move for a while…

trans-unit.source: よし、この地域はこれで|完全にブラックアウトだ。|さて、奴等はどう動く？
trans-unit.target: Alright, that just blacked out this whole region.|What’s their move now?

trans-unit.source: 敵もこのまま放っては|おかないだろう。|たぶん、ここに集まるな。
trans-unit.target: The enemy won't just let this stay broken.|They'll probably gather around here.

trans-unit.source: よし、目玉はつぶした。|さて、奴等はどう出るか。
trans-unit.target: Alright, those are their “eyes” smashed. Now what’ll they do?

trans-unit.source: …よけいな事しやがって。|ぶっ壊すだけだって、|意外と面倒なんだ。
trans-unit.target: …Ugh, that took ages.|Didn’t think it would be so hard to break this stuff.

trans-unit.source: とりあえず、しばらくは|おネンネしててくれよ。
trans-unit.target: Alright, time for you to take a nap. Rock-a-bye baby!

trans-unit.source: 一時しのぎだが、これで|奴等の目はごまかせる。
trans-unit.target: It’s only temporary, but this’ll trick them for a while.

trans-unit.source: とりあえず奴等に|見つかる事はないだろう。
trans-unit.target: They definitely won’t be able to find me for the time being.

trans-unit.source: １人でもワナにかかりゃ|奴等の動きも鈍るだろう。
trans-unit.target: Even one person falling into this trap should slow them down a lot.

trans-unit.source: さあ、こっちへ来い。|そうすりゃ楽にしてやるよ。
trans-unit.target: C’mon, just step right over here.|It’ll be quick.

trans-unit.source: 哀れな子羊はあんたかい？|諦めな、バイバイだ。
trans-unit.target: What a sad little lamb you look.|Give it up. It's bye-bye now.

trans-unit.source: こっちの邪魔するからだ。|仕方ないだろ。
trans-unit.target: This is what happens when you get in my way.|Can’t be helped, yeah?

trans-unit.source: かわいそうに。|しつこく追ってくるからだ。
trans-unit.target: Poor guy.|If only they hadn’t been on my tail.

trans-unit.source: まだまだ。奴等に最高の|ショウを見せてやろうぜ。
trans-unit.target: Oh, just wait. I'm about to put on the best show these guys will ever see.

trans-unit.source: 奴等けっこうダメージを|食らったみたいだな。
trans-unit.target: Looks like they've taken a lot of damage already.

trans-unit.source: まずは順調だな。
trans-unit.target: It's been smooth sailing so far.

trans-unit.source: ちっ…やられた…|こいつはマズイぜ。
trans-unit.target: Tch… They got me…|This is bad.

trans-unit.source: 奴等の力を|甘く見てたらしいな。
trans-unit.target: I might have underestimated those guys, huh.

trans-unit.source: 何てこった！|奴等に出し抜かれたぜ！
trans-unit.target: What the hell! They outsmarted me!

trans-unit.source: くそっ…まだだ。|まだ、どうとでもなる。
trans-unit.target: Shit… No, it's not over yet.|Everything's still going fine…

trans-unit.source: ちっ！ マズったか。|こんなの俺らしくないぜ。
trans-unit.target: Tch! Did I make a mistake?|That's not like me.

trans-unit.source: 検問か…まあ、|奴等にしては上出来だな。
trans-unit.target: A roadblock, huh…|That's pretty impressive, for their standards.

trans-unit.source: こりゃ少々、ルートを|考え直さなきゃならんか。
trans-unit.target: I guess I'll have to rethink my route a little.

trans-unit.source: あいつら、ちょっとは|やるじゃないか。
trans-unit.target: Huh, they've got some skills after all.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラなんて、|ルール違反だぜ。
trans-unit.target: Hey, hidden cameras are against the rules.

trans-unit.source: おいおい、こういうのは|違法捜査って言うんだ。
trans-unit.target: Oi, isn't this kind of thing illegal?

trans-unit.source: いつから捜査員は|こんなゴツイ隠し玉使って|いい事になったんだ？
trans-unit.target: Since when did it become okay for investigators to use these kinda sly tactics?

trans-unit.source: やったぜ！ いい調子だ。
trans-unit.target: Hell yeah! Let's keep this going!

trans-unit.source: 計画より遅れたな。|だが、まあ大丈夫だろう。
trans-unit.target: That took longer than I planned.|But eh, it's probably fine.

trans-unit.source: よし、次の計画だ。|うまくやれよ。
trans-unit.target: Alright, next plan. You'd better do well.

trans-unit.source: おいおい、|もう終わりかい？
trans-unit.target: Come on, over already?

trans-unit.source: ハハハ！|意外と楽勝じゃないか。
trans-unit.target: Hahaha! That was easier than I thought!

trans-unit.source: おっと！|勝っちまった！
trans-unit.target: Whoa! We won!#google says おっと is for mistakes? but apparently 'whoa' is acceptable. proofreading check i guess

trans-unit.source: ばかな…こんなはずじゃ…
trans-unit.target: Bullshit... This can't be happening...#too strong?

trans-unit.source: マズったな…|これで終わりかよ？
trans-unit.target: The jig's up…|Is this the end?

trans-unit.source: ちっ！ やられた！
trans-unit.target: Tch! They got me!

trans-unit.source: デスノートか。|こんなアブナイもん、|人には渡したくないね。
trans-unit.target: The Death Note, huh.|I don't really want to hand something this dangerous to people.

trans-unit.source: 俺はキラもニアも|どうでもいいんだがな。
trans-unit.target: Whether it's Kira or Near who comes out on top, I don't really care either way.

trans-unit.source: どうも頭脳戦ってのは|性に合わないな。|派手に行こうぜ！
trans-unit.target: Anyway, battles of wits just don't suit me.|I like being flashy, baby!

trans-unit.source: メロも損な性格だな。|悪い奴じゃないんだが。
trans-unit.target: Mello's personality sure is terrible…|But he's not a bad guy.

trans-unit.source: しばらく、うまいもん|食ってねえな。
trans-unit.target: Man, it's been a while since I've gotten any good food…

trans-unit.source: 日本もアメリカも|大して変わらないな。
trans-unit.target: Japan and America aren't really all that different, huh.

trans-unit.source: キラは本当に神になる|つもりなのか…
trans-unit.target: Does Kira really intend to become a god…?

trans-unit.source: 警察ってのはどこの国でも|やっかいな奴等だ。
trans-unit.target: No matter which country I'm in, the cops are always annoying bastards.

trans-unit.source: まずいな。|ここで無理するわけにも…
trans-unit.target: This is bad.|Even if I overdo it, there's no way out…

trans-unit.source: くそっ、発見されたか。
trans-unit.target: Dammit, did they find me?

trans-unit.source: ちっ…もう少しなのに、|ここで見つかるとは。
trans-unit.target: Ugh… We're so close, I can't get caught now.

trans-unit.source: どうしよう、これじゃ|ライトの役に立てないよ。
trans-unit.target: What do I do? I won't be useful to Light like this.

trans-unit.source: わっ、やばっ！|見つかっちゃった！
trans-unit.target: Ahhhh! No!|They found me!

trans-unit.source: ここで見つかるなんて…|もーっ、バカバカ！
trans-unit.target: Why would they find me here? This is all so stupid!

trans-unit.source: なんでーっ|あと少しだったのに！
trans-unit.target: What theeee… But I was so close!

trans-unit.source: あれはＳＰＫの…|やはり手は出さないな。
trans-unit.target: That's the SPK…|But they really aren't making any moves.

trans-unit.source: 発見されたか。|だが手出しはしないはずだ。
trans-unit.target: Have they found me?|But they shouldn't make any moves.

trans-unit.source: 奴等、何もしないな。|予想通りだ。
trans-unit.target: They aren't doing anything.|Just as I thought.

trans-unit.source: あの人達、何もしないのね。|ライトの言った通りだね。
trans-unit.target: Those people aren't doing anything, huh.|It's just like Light said.

trans-unit.source: あの人がＳＰＫ…でも|捕まえたりしないはず…
trans-unit.target: Those people are from the SPK… But they won't arrest me…

trans-unit.source: 発見されても大丈夫…|ライトはそう言ってたもん。
trans-unit.target: It'll be okay, even if they find me…|That's what Light said, anyway.

trans-unit.source: 発見されたな。|神…あとは計画の通りに…
trans-unit.target: So they've found me.|God… The rest will be according to your plan…

trans-unit.source: あれがＳＰＫか…だが、|私は神の仰せに従うまで…
trans-unit.target: So that's the SPK… But as long as I obey God's command, I should be fine…

trans-unit.source: 神の仰せの通りなら|奴等は手は出さないはず。
trans-unit.target: If everything goes according to God's will, they won't move a finger.

trans-unit.source: 地下鉄を使うか…|行動は制限されるが|今は問題ないはずだ。
trans-unit.target: I could use the subway…|My movements are restricted, but that shouldn’t be a problem right now.#investigator light start

trans-unit.source: 目的地付近でトラップに|出会うリスクはあるが、|覚悟の上だ。
trans-unit.target: There's a risk that I'll run into a trap near my destination, but I'm prepared to take that chance.

trans-unit.source: バス移動はトラップに|飛び込むリスクもあるが、|ここは一気に動くしかない。
trans-unit.target: There's a risk that I'll jump straight into a trap if I take the bus, but all I can do is push on.

trans-unit.source: 計算通りなら、これで|奴等より速く動けるはず！
trans-unit.target: If it all goes to plan, then I should be able to move faster than them with this!

trans-unit.source: 水上バスは移動は速いが、|動きが制限されるのが|問題だな。注意しなければ…
trans-unit.target: Going by water-bus is fast, but my movement being limited is a problem. I should be careful…

trans-unit.source: 少々目立つがやむを得ない。|先回りだ。
trans-unit.target: This is somewhat conspicuous but I have no choice. I need to get ahead.#ish

trans-unit.source: どんな交通手段も|ヘリにはかなわない。|これで先手を取ってやる。
trans-unit.target: Nothing beats a helicopter for getting around. This'll help us get a step ahead.

trans-unit.source: ここでヘリを使うとは|奴等には予想もできない|だろう。
trans-unit.target: Those people can’t possibly have expected me to use a helicopter, right?|They’ll never see me coming.

trans-unit.source: 容疑者を確保した！
trans-unit.target: I've apprehended a suspect!

trans-unit.source: 月です。容疑者逮捕。|捜査本部へ連行します。
trans-unit.target: This is Light. I've arrested a suspect. I'm bringing them to headquarters.

trans-unit.source: 残念だったね。|僕等から逃げられるはず|ないだろう？
trans-unit.target: It's a shame, really. You were never going to be able to escape us, were you?

trans-unit.source: そ、そんな…この僕が！
trans-unit.target: N-no! This can't be happening to me!

trans-unit.source: しまった！ こんなはずは…
trans-unit.target: Damn it! How did this happen…

trans-unit.source: なにっ！ トラップだと！？
trans-unit.target: What? A trap!?

trans-unit.source: 容疑者を確認！|予想通りだ！
trans-unit.target: I've confirmed a suspect! Just as I thought!

trans-unit.source: 見つけた！|奴等のメンバーだ。
trans-unit.target: Found one! A member of Team Kira.#adjust in case he’s talking about yotsuba

trans-unit.source: こいつ！|奴等の仲間の１人だ。
trans-unit.target: This person is one of the enemy Team!#check during proofread

trans-unit.source: だめだ。|怪しい人物はいないな。
trans-unit.target: It's no good. There's no one suspicious here.

trans-unit.source: ちっ…失敗か。|どうすればいいんだ。
trans-unit.target: Tch... No luck, then. What should I do?

trans-unit.source: 奴等、どこにいるんだ……
trans-unit.target: Damn it, where are they…

trans-unit.source: 容疑者を確認。|映像を再生する。
trans-unit.target: Confirming a suspect. Playing back the footage now.

trans-unit.source: 見つけた！ 映像を確認だ。
trans-unit.target: I found one! Checking the footage now.

trans-unit.source: やった！|敵のメンバーが映ってる！
trans-unit.target: Yes! There's a member of the enemy team in the footage!

trans-unit.source: ダメか！|この辺りじゃないのか？
trans-unit.target: Nothing...! Are they not in this area?

trans-unit.source: 手がかりは何も映ってないな。
trans-unit.target: There aren't any clues in this footage.

trans-unit.source: 映像では怪しい人物は|どこにもいない…失敗か。
trans-unit.target: I don't see any suspicious people in the footage... No luck this time.

trans-unit.source: カメラの修復を完了。|ちゃんと見えてますか？
trans-unit.target: I've finished camera repairs. Is the image coming through alright?

trans-unit.source: くそっ…奴等め…|よけいな手間を|かけさせてくれる。
trans-unit.target: Damn... Those bastards, making us waste time we don't have...

trans-unit.source: よしＯＫ。それにしても、|この破壊は敵の陽動なのか？|それとも主犯のしわざか…
trans-unit.target: Okay, got it. Even so, was this destruction an enemy diversion? Or was it the work of the mastermind…

trans-unit.source: 周辺一帯の封鎖を完了した。|これで逃げ場はないだろう。
trans-unit.target: I finished blockading this area. Now there's nowhere for them to run to.

trans-unit.source: これで奴等は通れないはずだ。|作戦を続行する。
trans-unit.target: Now they shouldn't be able to get through here. Continuing with the plan.

trans-unit.source: こいつでうまく誘導できれば、|こちらの勝ちは間違いない。
trans-unit.target: If I play my cards right and draw that person out, there's no doubt victory will be ours.

trans-unit.source: 仕方がない。|これ以上の検問維持は|無意味だろうな。
trans-unit.target: It's no use. Trying to maintain this roadblock any longer is meaningless.

trans-unit.source: 検問はダメだったか。|だが、まあいいだろう。
trans-unit.target: The roadblock didn't work out, then. Ah well, we'll be fine.

trans-unit.source: この検問はもう用済みだ。|別の手を考えよう。
trans-unit.target: This roadblock has done its job. Time to think up a new strategy.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラか。|気は進まないけど、|そうも言ってられないな。
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera... I don't like it, but it's not like I can say that.

trans-unit.source: これが役に立ってくれれば|次の手が打てるだろう。
trans-unit.target: If this gets us anything useful, we’ll be able to make our next move.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラの効果は|僕もよく知っている。|うまくいくといいが…
trans-unit.target: I know very well how effective hidden cameras can be. It would be nice if they worked well here, too…

trans-unit.source: この裏路地を敵は知らない。|うまく行くはずだ。
trans-unit.target: The enemy doesn't know about this back alley. I'm sure it'll work.

trans-unit.source: これで奴等の裏を|かけるかもしれない。
trans-unit.target: I might be able to outwit them with this.

trans-unit.source: 裏路地なんて|あまり使いたくなかったが|ここは仕方ないな。
trans-unit.target: I don’t really want to use something like a back alley, but there’s no other way around it.

trans-unit.source: どうも近くに|敵の気配を感じるな。
trans-unit.target: I can sense an enemy nearby.#ish

trans-unit.source: ！ あいつ…|どこかで見た事が…
trans-unit.target: ! That person…|Seems familiar somehow…

trans-unit.source: いやな予感がする…|もしかすると…
trans-unit.target: I've got a bad feeling about this... Could there be…

trans-unit.source: この隠しカメラは|回収した方がいいな。
trans-unit.target: It's best to retrieve this hidden camera.

trans-unit.source: いったん回収しておこう。
trans-unit.target: I'll retrieve this one for now.

trans-unit.source: こいつは回収だ。|また使う事も|あるかもしれないが。
trans-unit.target: I'll retrieve this. We might be able to use it again.

trans-unit.source: 地下鉄で移動するので、|一時的に連絡不通になります。|よろしいですかな。
trans-unit.target: I will be traveling underground and will be temporarily out of contact. I do hope that's okay.#watari start (SERIOUSLY? WATARI?)

trans-unit.source: ここは地下鉄を使いますかな。|その間、連絡はできませんが|ご心配なく。
trans-unit.target: I am about to enter the underground. I will be unreachable during this time, but there’s no need for concern.

trans-unit.source: 降りた直後のトラップさえ|警戒すれば、|地下鉄も便利なものです。
trans-unit.target: As long as one remains wary of any traps upon disembarking, the subway is quite a useful option.

trans-unit.source: 目的地までバスを使います。|行動範囲は少しでも広い方が|よろしいでしょう。
trans-unit.target: I will take the bus to my destination. Expanding the scope of my investigation should prove useful.

trans-unit.source: 私は高速バスで移動します。|その間に次の策を|考えていただけますかな。
trans-unit.target: I will take the express bus. Perhaps I can use this time to consider my next course of action.

trans-unit.source: バスも他の乗物同様、|降りた直後のリスクが高い。|それはおわかりでしょうな。
trans-unit.target: When disembarking a mode of transport into a new area, we investigators are at the most risk. I trust you’re aware of that.

trans-unit.source: 水上バスの速さは、かなりの|ものです。計算通りなら敵に、|追いつけるかもしれません。
trans-unit.target: The water bus moves at a rather impressive speed. If my calculations are correct, I may be able to catch up with the target.

trans-unit.source: ワタリです。|水上バスで敵を追います。|地上は任せますぞ。
trans-unit.target: This is Watari. I will pursue the suspects by water-bus. I leave operations on the surface in your hands.

trans-unit.source: 常に敵の先手を取る…|Ｌはいつも|そうしておりました。
trans-unit.target: Always staying one step ahead of your enemy… That is what L constantly strives for.

trans-unit.source: ヘリは少々目立ちますが、|この速さを利用しない手は|ありますまい。
trans-unit.target: A helicopter does draw attention, but with this speed, it would be unwise not to make use of it.

trans-unit.source: 問題は敵より速く動けるか|どうかです。多少目立っても|ヘリ移動は効果があります。
trans-unit.target: It is simply a matter of who can move faster, myself or the enemy. Helicopters may stand out, but there is no denying how effective they are.

trans-unit.source: ワタリです。|空から敵を追います。|地上は任せましたぞ。
trans-unit.target: This is Watari. I will pursue the suspects by air. I leave operations on the surface in your hands.

trans-unit.source: ワタリです。|犯人を確保しました。
trans-unit.target: This is Watari. I have a suspect in my custody.

trans-unit.source: 捜査本部へ。犯人を逮捕。|捜査本部へ連行します。
trans-unit.target: Suspect has been arrested. We are en route to headquarters.

trans-unit.source: 残念でしたな。|ですが、永久に逃げられる|ものではありませんよ。
trans-unit.target: How unfortunate. However, you can't have expected to be able to run forever.

trans-unit.source: なんと…私とした事が…
trans-unit.target: Impossible... What have I...?

trans-unit.source: しまった！ Ｌ…！
trans-unit.target: My apologies... L...!

trans-unit.source: …してやられましたか…
trans-unit.target: ...It seems they've found me…

trans-unit.source: 聞こえますか？|容疑者を確認しました。
trans-unit.target: Can you hear me?|I've confirmed the suspect.

trans-unit.source: 敵を発見しました。|間違いないでしょう。
trans-unit.target: I believe I have located the target.

trans-unit.source: これが犯人でしょうな。|さて、どうしますか…
trans-unit.target: This individual appears to be the target. Now, how to proceed…

trans-unit.source: 犯人らしい者は|どこにもおりませんな…
trans-unit.target: There's no one matching the suspect's description.

trans-unit.source: 失敗でした。|怪しい人物はおりません。
trans-unit.target: It appears to be a bust. There is no one suspicious.

trans-unit.source: ダメでしたか…|しかし、いずれ必ず|見つかるはずです。
trans-unit.target: This is unfortunate... But I'm certain we shall find them in due course.

trans-unit.source: 犯人らしい人物を確認。|映像を再生します。
trans-unit.target: I have confirmed a likely suspect. Playing back the footage now.

trans-unit.source: 映像からは、この人物が|怪しいと思われます。
trans-unit.target: From the video, this individual appears to be suspicious.

trans-unit.source: 映像を確認してください。|犯人が映っています。
trans-unit.target: Please review the footage. The suspect has been captured on tape.

trans-unit.source: 失敗でしたか。この周辺には、|いないのかもしれませんな。
trans-unit.target: No luck, it seems. Perhaps the target is not in this vicinity.

trans-unit.source: 映像には、|それらしい手がかりは|ありませんでした。
trans-unit.target: The footage yielded no promising leads.

trans-unit.source: 怪しい人物は|記録されていません。|場所を変えるべきですかな。
trans-unit.target: No one in the footage matches the suspect's description. Perhaps I ought to try another location.

trans-unit.source: カメラを修復しました。|これで大丈夫のはずです。
trans-unit.target: I have repaired the camera. It should be working now.

trans-unit.source: やっと修復が完了しました。|さて、捜査を急ぎませんと。
trans-unit.target: I have finally finished repairs. Now I must make haste with the investigation.

trans-unit.source: 修復完了です。|どうやら目標の誰かが|近くにいたようですな。
trans-unit.target: The repair is complete. It appears that one of our targets was nearby.

trans-unit.source: この周辺の封鎖を完了。|これで犯人の逃げ場は|ありますまい。
trans-unit.target: I have sealed off the area. The suspect has nowhere left to run.

trans-unit.source: ワタリです。|検問を設置しました。|捜査に戻ります。
trans-unit.target: This is Watari. The roadblock has been assembled. I shall resume my investigation.

trans-unit.source: 検問を使った犯人誘導。|なかなかうまい手です。
trans-unit.target: Using a roadblock to control a suspect's movements is rather handy.

trans-unit.source: 検問を解除しますぞ。|よろしいですな。
trans-unit.target: Very well, I will disassemble the roadblock now.

trans-unit.source: なるほど。|この検問はもう用済み|というわけですな。
trans-unit.target: I see. So, this roadblock has outlived its usefulness.

trans-unit.source: 検問を解除しますが、|今後はこちら方面にも|注意が必要ですな。
trans-unit.target: I will disassemble the roadblock, but we must remain vigilant of anyone trying to pass through this direction.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラですな。|わかりました。|ではさっそく…
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera, is it?|Understood. I’ll proceed at once.

trans-unit.source: なるほど、これなら|役に立つかもしれませんな。
trans-unit.target: I see. This may well prove useful.

trans-unit.source: 日本では使われませんが、|隠しカメラの効果は|大きいと思いますよ。
trans-unit.target: Hidden cameras are not commonly used in Japan, although I do believe they have their uses.

trans-unit.source: この道を使えば|犯人の裏をかく事も|可能でしょう。
trans-unit.target: Using this route, I may be able to outwit the suspects.

trans-unit.source: 敵より少しでも先回り|できるといいのですが…
trans-unit.target: If I can stay one step ahead of the enemy, all the better…

trans-unit.source: 裏路地ですか…|子供の頃は遊び場でしたな。
trans-unit.target: Taking a back alley... I used to play in places like this as a child.

trans-unit.source: このあたりに誰か|隠れていそうですが。
trans-unit.target: I suspect that someone may be hiding nearby.

trans-unit.source: ふむ…|何かありそうな気配が…
trans-unit.target: Hm... I have a feeling that something is here.

trans-unit.source: こちらの動きを|読まれたかもしれませんな。
trans-unit.target: It's possible our movements have been anticipated by the enemy.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラを回収します。
trans-unit.target: Retrieving the hidden camera now.

trans-unit.source: この隠しカメラは|回収ですな。
trans-unit.target: This hidden camera has outlived its usefulness.

trans-unit.source: 回収いたしました。
trans-unit.target: Recovery complete.

trans-unit.source: こちら夜神だ。|これより地下鉄で移動する。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I'm about to board the subway.#soichiro start

trans-unit.source: 地下鉄では降りるまで|地上と連絡はできないが|仕方あるまい。
trans-unit.target: I won’t be able to contact the surface while I’m underground, but there's not much I can do about that now.

trans-unit.source: 降りた直後のトラップ…|そのリスクはあるが、|覚悟の上だ。
trans-unit.target: There is the risk of running into traps once I get off the subway, but I am prepared for that.

trans-unit.source: 捜査範囲を広げるためだ。|トラップに踏み込むリスクは|覚悟の上…
trans-unit.target: Widening the scope of the investigation is worth the risk of falling into a trap.

trans-unit.source: 夜神だ。高速バスを使うぞ。|しばらく連絡不通になるが|心配はいらん。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I'm about to board the express bus. I'll be out of contact for a while, but there’s no need to worry.

trans-unit.source: 敵が一体どんな連中なのか…|移動中に少し落ち着いて|考えてみよう。
trans-unit.target: What are the enemy really after... I'll use this time to get my thoughts in order.

trans-unit.source: 水上バスなら、敵より速く|動けるはずだ。|これで追いつくかもしれん。
trans-unit.target: If I take the water-bus, I should be able to move faster than the enemy. I may be able to catch them up.

trans-unit.source: こちら夜神。水上バスで|容疑者を追う。|しばらくの間、地上は頼む。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I am in pursuit via water-bus. Please handle things on your side.

trans-unit.source: 敵の先手を取れれば、|必ず我々が勝つはずだ。
trans-unit.target: If we can get a head start on the enemy, we can beat them.

trans-unit.source: ヘリまで使う事になるとは。|だが、容疑者より先回りする|ためなら仕方あるまい。
trans-unit.target: I never thought we'd have to go as far as using helicopters for this. But if it helps us cut them off, I’ll do it.

trans-unit.source: これなら、確かに他の|交通手段より速く移動できる。|しかし、少々目立つな…
trans-unit.target: This is definitely faster than other means of transport. But, it's not going to go unnoticed…

trans-unit.source: こちら夜神。|空から容疑者を追跡する。|しばらくの間、地上は頼む。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I am in pursuit via helicopter. Please handle things on your side.

trans-unit.source: 夜神だ。容疑者を確保した！
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I've secured the suspect!

trans-unit.source: 捜査本部へ。|容疑者を逮捕したぞ。|ただちに連行する。
trans-unit.target: HQ, do you copy? The suspect has been apprehended. I'm bringing them in.

trans-unit.source: 我々の捜査から|逃げられると思ったのか？|ばかな奴だ。
trans-unit.target: Did you really think you could slip through the net? How foolish.

trans-unit.source: ま、まさか…トラップか！？
trans-unit.target: It can't be... A trap!?

trans-unit.source: そ、捜査本部…あとを頼む…
trans-unit.target: E-Everyone... I leave the rest to you…

trans-unit.source: こんな所で…やられるとは…
trans-unit.target: No... In a place like this…

trans-unit.source: 容疑者を確認した！
trans-unit.target: I’ve got eyes on the suspect!

trans-unit.source: いたぞ！ 容疑者だ！
trans-unit.target: There! That’s our suspect!

trans-unit.source: 容疑者だ。間違いない！
trans-unit.target: That's the suspect! There's no doubt about it.

trans-unit.source: 容疑者らしい人物は|発見できんか…
trans-unit.target: I don't see anything suspicious…

trans-unit.source: 失敗だ。怪しい奴は|どこにもいない。
trans-unit.target: This one's a bust. The suspects aren't here.

trans-unit.source: 容疑者は必ず、この街の|どこかにいるはずだ。|だが、それは一体……
trans-unit.target: The suspect has to be somewhere in this city… but where exactly?

trans-unit.source: 映像を見てくれ、容疑者だ！
trans-unit.target: Watch this back, there's our suspect!

trans-unit.source: 容疑者らしい人物を映像で|確認した。これを見てくれ。
trans-unit.target: I've identified a suspect in this footage. Take a look.

trans-unit.source: やったぞ！ 成功だ。|容疑者が映ってる！
trans-unit.target: Yes! We've got them. You can clearly see the suspect in this footage.

trans-unit.source: ダメだったか…|この辺りには|いないというのか？
trans-unit.target: Nothing... Does that mean the suspects aren't in this area?

trans-unit.source: 映像には手がかりはない。|しかし、きっとどこかに…
trans-unit.target: The footage doesn't provide any leads. But, there must be something, somewhere…

trans-unit.source: 映像中にはどこにも|怪しい人物はいない。|…失敗だ。
trans-unit.target: There's nothing suspicious in here at all.|...It's a complete failure.

trans-unit.source: カメラの修復は完了した。|動作を確認してくれ。
trans-unit.target: The camera has been repaired. Can you test it to make sure it's working?

trans-unit.source: やっと修復できたな。|捜査を急がなければ…
trans-unit.target: That's one job done. Now I need to get back to the investigation.

trans-unit.source: 容疑者は近くにいたはずだ。|しかし、それが陽動だった|可能性もあるな。
trans-unit.target: A suspect must have been nearby. Unless this was just a diversion...

trans-unit.source: 周辺の道路を封鎖した。|あとは容疑者を|追い込むだけだ。
trans-unit.target: I've sealed off the road. Now we just need to close in on the suspect.

trans-unit.source: 容疑者は検問には近づくまい。|捜査地域を絞るには|役立つはずだ。
trans-unit.target: A smart criminal will steer well clear of a roadblock. That narrows our search area.

trans-unit.source: この検問は、もはや無意味か。|解除するしかあるまい。
trans-unit.target: Is this roadblock useless now? I guess I'd better dismantle it.

trans-unit.source: 検問はダメだったか。|だが、別の手はあるだろう。
trans-unit.target: So the roadblock was a bust... But we're not out of options yet.

trans-unit.source: 夜神だ。この検問を解除する。|以後、この周辺にも捜査員の|注意が必要だ。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I'm lifting the roadblock, but we should still keep eyes on this area.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラとは…|日本警察のする事ではないが、|仕方あるまい。
trans-unit.target: Hidden cameras aren't permitted in the police force, but I suppose I have no choice now.

trans-unit.source: これが少しでも役に立つなら、|強引でもやるしかない。|責任は私が取る。
trans-unit.target: If this can give us even a small lead, I'll do it. I take full responsibility.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラの効果は|私にも理解できる。|うまくいくといいが…
trans-unit.target: I can understand the potential of a hidden camera. I just hope they work as intended…

trans-unit.source: この方法なら|容疑者に気づかれず|動けるだろう。
trans-unit.target: This way I can move without alerting the suspect.

trans-unit.source: 少しでも敵より|先回りできればいいが…
trans-unit.target: Maybe this'll help me get ahead of the enemy.

trans-unit.source: 裏路地か…これなら…
trans-unit.target: A back alley. If I take this…

trans-unit.source: …近くに誰かいるな。
trans-unit.target: ...Someone's close.

trans-unit.source: 何か見落としを|しているような…
trans-unit.target: I feel like I'm overlooking something…

trans-unit.source: どうも誰かに|見られているような気が…
trans-unit.target: I can't shake the feeling that someone’s watching me…

trans-unit.source: 夜神だ。|隠しカメラを回収した。
trans-unit.target: This is Yagami. I've retrieved the hidden camera.

trans-unit.source: カメラ回収完了した。
trans-unit.target: I've finished retrieving this camera.

trans-unit.source: カメラを回収したぞ。
trans-unit.target: I've secured the camera.

trans-unit.source: ここは地下鉄で|一気に移動といきますか。
trans-unit.target: Alright, let's take the subway, maybe? #matsuda start

trans-unit.source: こちら松田。これから|地下鉄で移動します。|連絡なくても大丈夫っすよ。
trans-unit.target: This is Matsuda. I'm taking the subway, so don't worry if I'm not in contact for a bit, okay?

trans-unit.source: 降りた途端にトラップじゃ|シャレになんないから|気をつけないとな。

trans-unit.source: 失敗でした。|怪しい人物はいません。

trans-unit.source: 検問を使えば、あるいは|キラ達をこちらの捜査網に|誘導できるかも。

trans-unit.source: た、助けて！ トラップだ！
trans-unit.target: H-help! It's a trap!

trans-unit.source: い、いやだ…こんな所で！
trans-unit.target: N-no... Not like this!

trans-unit.source: 犯人を発見！|間違いありません。
trans-unit.target: I've found the culprit! There's no doubt about it.

trans-unit.source: 犯人グループの情報を|確認しました！
trans-unit.target: I've secured information about the enemy group!

trans-unit.source: 犯人の仲間を|発見しました。
trans-unit.target: I found one of the culprit’s accomplices.

trans-unit.source: ダメです。|怪しい人物はどこにも…
trans-unit.target: It's no good. I don't see anyone suspicious anywhere…

trans-unit.source: 有力な情報は|ありませんでした。
trans-unit.target: There was no promising information.

trans-unit.source: ダメでした。この辺りに|犯人の情報はありません。
trans-unit.target: It's no good. There isn't any information on the culprit in this area.

trans-unit.source: 映像中に犯人を|発見しました！
trans-unit.target: I found the culprit in the footage!

trans-unit.source: 見つけました！|これが犯人でしょう。
trans-unit.target: I found one! This must be our culprit.

trans-unit.source: 犯人の仲間と思われる|人間を発見しました。
trans-unit.target: I found someone who appears to be an accomplice of the culprit.

trans-unit.source: 失敗です。この周辺に|犯人はいない模様です。
trans-unit.target: This was a failure. It appears the culprit is not in this area.

trans-unit.source: ダメです。|何の情報もありません。
trans-unit.target: It's no good. There's no information here.

trans-unit.source: 失敗です。|怪しい人物はいません。
trans-unit.target: I failed. There are no suspicious people here.

trans-unit.source: カメラを修復しました。
trans-unit.target: I have repaired the camera.

trans-unit.source: 修復完了。|だいぶ時間を取られましたが、|捜査に戻ります。
trans-unit.target: Repairs complete. It took quite some time, but I can now return to the investigation.

trans-unit.source: カメラが破壊されたのは、|この近くに犯人がいるという|事ではないでしょうか。
trans-unit.target: A camera was destroyed here, does that mean that the culprit is nearby?

trans-unit.source: 辺り一帯を封鎖しました。|これでもう犯人は通れません。
trans-unit.target: I have blocked off this entire area. Now the culprit can no longer pass through here.

trans-unit.source: 検問設置を完了しました。
trans-unit.target: Roadblock assembly complete.

trans-unit.source: 検問を設置。後は犯人が|こちらの網にかかるのを|待つだけですね。
trans-unit.target: Roadblock assembled. Now all we have to do is wait for them to get caught in our net.

trans-unit.source: 検問解除、了解しました。|仕方がありませんね。
trans-unit.target: Roadblock disassembly complete. It couldn't be helped, I suppose.

trans-unit.source: 検問は失敗でした。|怪しい人物は網に|引っかかりません。
trans-unit.target: This roadblock was a failure. No suspicious persons were caught here.

trans-unit.source: 了解。検問を解除します。
trans-unit.target: Understood. Disassembling the roadblock.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラですか？|いえ、命令ならやりますが…
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera? No, if it's an order then I'll do it, but…

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラ、|役に立つでしょうか？
trans-unit.target: Will a hidden camera prove useful?

trans-unit.source: 了解しました。|隠しカメラ設置を手配します。
trans-unit.target: Understood. Placing hidden camera.

trans-unit.source: この裏路地は|犯人も知らないはずですね。
trans-unit.target: There's no way the criminal knows about this back alley.

trans-unit.source: 了解です。|裏路地から回り込みます。
trans-unit.target: Understood. I will circle around through the back alley.

trans-unit.source: 裏路地なら表通りより|はるかに安全ですね。
trans-unit.target: Back alleys are far safer than the main streets.

trans-unit.source: う…近くに誰かいるような…
trans-unit.target: Ah... I think there's someone close by…

trans-unit.source: …あいつ、どこかで…
trans-unit.target: Have I seen them somewhere before...?

trans-unit.source: 気のせいかな？|誰かに見られてるような…
trans-unit.target: Is it just my imagination? I feel as though I'm being watched…

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラを回収した。
trans-unit.target: Hidden camera retrieved.

trans-unit.source: カメラ回収完了です。
trans-unit.target: I have finished retrieving a camera.

trans-unit.source: 回収しました。
trans-unit.target: I have retrieved it.

trans-unit.source: 少し急いだ方がよさそうだ。|ここは地下鉄を使うか。
trans-unit.target: I should pick up my pace. Maybe now is a good time to use the subway.#ish

trans-unit.source: バスなら、しばらく|追手の心配はない。
trans-unit.target: Taking the bus means I don't have to worry about being followed for a while.

trans-unit.source: 急いだ方がいいな。|ここからなら水上バスが|早いだろう。
trans-unit.target: I should hurry. The fastest thing from here is the water-bus, right?

trans-unit.source: これなら一番速いし|追いつける人間はいないな。
trans-unit.target: This is my fastest option, and there won't be anyone following me either.

trans-unit.source: ちっ…これで私も終わりか。
trans-unit.target: Tch... Guess my number's up.

trans-unit.source: わかった、抵抗はしない。
trans-unit.target: Got it, I won't fight back.

trans-unit.source: こうなっては仕方ないな。
trans-unit.target: I've got no choice now that it's come to this.#check

trans-unit.source: これを預かってくれ。|どう利用するかは任せる。
trans-unit.target: Take care of this for me. How you use it is up to you.

trans-unit.source: 我々の運命がかかってるんだ。|使い方を間違えるなよ。
trans-unit.target: Our fate is riding on this. Don't misuse it.

trans-unit.source: 悪いな。今度はおまえが|ノートのお守りをしてくれ。
trans-unit.target: Sorry. You'll have to protect the Note this time.

trans-unit.source: 警察は諦めそうにないか。|こうなれば他に手はない。
trans-unit.target: Looks like the cops won't back down. This is our only option now.

trans-unit.source: やむを得ん、ここは|ノートを使うしかない。
trans-unit.target: There's no other way. I'll have to use the notebook.

trans-unit.source: 犠牲者には申し訳ないが、|まだ、捕まるわけには|いかないからな。
trans-unit.target: I feel bad for the sacrifices, but I can't afford to be caught. Not yet.

trans-unit.source: …あっけなく人が倒せる。|やはり恐ろしいものだな。
trans-unit.target: ...How quickly people fall. It truly is a terrifying power.

trans-unit.source: 追跡を諦めていれば|無事でいられたものを…|バカな奴等だ。
trans-unit.target: They'd be safe if only they gave up the chase... Idiots.

trans-unit.source: 悪いな。我々が捕まれば|ヨツバの命運に関わる。
trans-unit.target: Sorry. But if we get caught, the Yotsuba will suffer for it.#ish

trans-unit.source: よし、これで少し|身動きがとりやすくなる。
trans-unit.target: Good, now it should be a bit easier to move around.

trans-unit.source: これでしばらく|時間をかせげるだろう。
trans-unit.target: That should buy us some time.

trans-unit.source: カメラには油断できない。|他も破壊すべきか…
trans-unit.target: I can't get careless with the cameras. Should I take down some others too...?

trans-unit.source: ここは変装してやり過ごすか。
trans-unit.target: I guess I'll disguise myself and let them pass me by.

trans-unit.source: ばかばかしいが|効果的かもしれないな。
trans-unit.target: This is absurd but it could be effective.

trans-unit.source: とりあえずこの姿なら|しばらくはごまかせるだろう。
trans-unit.target: I'll take this guise for now, that should confuse them for a little while.

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラとは古典的だな。|だが効果は大きい。
trans-unit.target: Hidden cameras, huh. A classic. But they are very effective.

trans-unit.source: ……奴等は|こんなものまで使うのか。
trans-unit.target: ...They'll stoop to using this too?#ish

trans-unit.source: 放置するのは危険だな。|どうすべきか…
trans-unit.target: It's dangerous to leave this alone. What should I do...?

trans-unit.source: わかった。|だが、これを使うかどうかは|別問題だぞ。
trans-unit.target: Got it. But whether I use it or not is a different issue entirely.#pretty sure it's i? but check

trans-unit.source: これを渡されるのは|やはり気が重いな。
trans-unit.target: I'm reluctant to take this after all.

trans-unit.source: 正直、これを預かるのは|願い下げにしたいが…
trans-unit.target: Honestly, I'd rather refuse and not hold onto this, but…

trans-unit.source: この地域の監視網は落ちた…|動くなら今のうちだな。
trans-unit.target: The surveillance network in this area has collapsed... If I'm going to move, now's the time.

trans-unit.source: いずれ敵は監視網の復旧に|集まるだろう。|さて、どうするか…
trans-unit.target: The enemy will likely rally to restore the surveillance network at some point. Now then, what do I do…

trans-unit.source: さて、今のうちに|次の手を考えなければ。
trans-unit.target: Now then, I have to think of my next move while I still can.

trans-unit.source: 奴は無理だ。|ノートより奴の方が危険だ。
trans-unit.target: Giving it to them is out of the question. They're more dangerous than the Note is.

trans-unit.source: 奴にノートを渡せば|こちらの身が危なくなる。
trans-unit.target: If I give the Note to them, then that'll put me in danger.

trans-unit.source: 地下鉄で行くか。|多少は急がんと追いつかれる。
trans-unit.target: Guess I'll take the subway. They'll catch me up if I don't pick up the pace.#ish

trans-unit.source: こっちが高速バスに|乗ってしまえば警察も|気づくまい。
trans-unit.target: The police won't pay me any mind if I take the express bus.

trans-unit.source: 水の上までは追跡の手も|延びてはくるまい。
trans-unit.target: They don't have the reach to follow me across the water, too.#ish

trans-unit.source: ふん…俺もここまでか。
trans-unit.target: Hmph. Is this as far as I go?

trans-unit.source: 今さら、ジタバタしても|始まらん。好きにしろ。
trans-unit.target: Struggling won't get me anywhere now. Do whatever you want.

trans-unit.source: 俺を逮捕するのか？|抵抗は無意味のようだな。
trans-unit.target: You're going to arrest me? Looks like there's no point in resisting.

trans-unit.source: こいつを渡す。|まだ利用価値はあるだろう。
trans-unit.target: I'll give it over. There's probably still some utility value left.#check

trans-unit.source: 扱いには注意しろ。|ミサイル並の危険物だ。
trans-unit.target: Careful how you handle it. This is as dangerous as a missile.

trans-unit.source: ここらでこんな物は|手放させてもらうぞ。
trans-unit.target: I'll be dropping this here, thank you very much.#check

trans-unit.source: しつこい連中だ。|…やるしかないだろうな。
trans-unit.target: Persistent bastards. ...Guess I have no choice.

trans-unit.source: 誰かを犠牲にしても|ここを切り抜けられるなら|やむを得ん。
trans-unit.target: If it means cutting through here then I have no choice, even if someone is sacrificed in the process.

trans-unit.source: これを使って|追跡さえ振り切れれば|それで解決だ。
trans-unit.target: If I can use this to shake off my pursuers then that will solve my problem.

trans-unit.source: 本当に簡単に終わるものだ。|気分のいいもんじゃないが。
trans-unit.target: Lives really come to an end so easily. Not that it's a pleasant feeling.

trans-unit.source: 追跡を諦めていれば|無事でいられたものを…|バカな奴等だ。
trans-unit.target: They'd be safe if only they gave up the chase... Idiots.

trans-unit.source: 恨むなよ。|これもヨツバを守るため|だからな。
trans-unit.target: Don't take it personally. This is all to protect the Yotsuba.

trans-unit.source: くっ…ちゃちなわりに|壊すには手間取るな。
trans-unit.target: Damn... For something so shoddily made, it sure takes time to destroy.

trans-unit.source: もっと簡単に壊れると|思ったが、まぁいい。
trans-unit.target: I thought this would break more easily. Ah well.

trans-unit.source: どうせこれ１台じゃ|ないんだろうが、|まぁ、いいだろ。
trans-unit.target: There's probably more than one of these anyway. Ah well, whatever.#check

trans-unit.source: 変装…くだらんが|他にうまい手もないか。
trans-unit.target: A disguise... I don't care for it but there's no better way.

trans-unit.source: これで誰にも|俺だとは、わからんだろ。
trans-unit.target: Now no one should know it's me.

trans-unit.source: くそっ…この俺が|こんな事をするとは…
trans-unit.target: Shit... This can't be happening to me…

trans-unit.source: まずいな…|ちゃちな仕掛けだが|効果はある。
trans-unit.target: Not good... It might be shoddily made but it's still effective.

trans-unit.source: ふん、奴等も下らん手を|使うものだ。
trans-unit.target: Hmph, they resort to dirty tricks too.#ish

trans-unit.source: 隠しカメラか…|一応、何か手を打たねばな。
trans-unit.target: A hidden camera... I should do something about it, just in case.

trans-unit.source: わかった。受け取っておく。
trans-unit.target: Got it. I'll take it off your hands.

trans-unit.source: ふん、仕方ないな。
trans-unit.target: Fine, I suppose I have no choice.

trans-unit.source: これを俺にか？|まだミサイル渡された方が|マシな気がするな。
trans-unit.target: You're giving this to me? I feel like even being handed a missile would be better than this.

trans-unit.source: よし、これで周辺の監視は|当分できんはずだ。
trans-unit.target: Alright, now they won't be able to use surveillance in this area for the time being.

trans-unit.source: これでしばらく警察は|復旧に手間取るだろう。
trans-unit.target: Now it'll take a while for the police to restore this.

trans-unit.source: 警察の動きも、これで|しばらく鈍るだろう。
trans-unit.target: This should slow down the police's movements for a while.

trans-unit.source: 無理だ。|奴は信用できん。
trans-unit.target: Absolutely not. I can't trust them.

trans-unit.source: あんな信用できん奴に|渡せるわけがない。
trans-unit.target: There's no way I can hand it over to someone as untrustworthy as that.

trans-unit.source: いや、やめた方がいい。|こちらの身が危なくなる。
trans-unit.target: No, best to hold off for now. It would put me in danger.

trans-unit.source: 地下鉄か。|歩くよりはマシだな。
trans-unit.target: The subway, huh. Beats walking.

trans-unit.source: 高速バスね…|サービスは期待できないが、|まあ、がまんするか。
trans-unit.target: The express bus, huh... The service isn't anything to write home about but I guess I can stick it out.

trans-unit.source: 警察…しつこいな。|仕方ない。水上バスに乗るか。
trans-unit.target: The cops... Damn, they're persistent. There's nothing for it. I'll take the water-bus.

trans-unit.source: ヘリか…乗りなれているし|ちょうどいいな。
trans-unit.target: A helicopter... Perfect, I can get used to riding around in one.#ish?

trans-unit.source: ちっ…これで私も終わりか。
trans-unit.target: Tch... Guess my number's up.

trans-unit.source: …いずれ、こんな事になると|思ってはいたが…
trans-unit.target: ...I thought it would come to this at some point, but…

trans-unit.source: 今さら悪あがきしても|ムダなんだろう？
trans-unit.target: There's no point uselessly struggling at this point, right?

trans-unit.source: ノートを渡す。|そっちでうまく使えよ。
trans-unit.target: I'll give you the Note. Make good use of it.

trans-unit.source: ノートの危険性は|わかっているな？
trans-unit.target: You do know how dangerous the Note is, right?

trans-unit.source: 悪いがノートはおまえに渡す。|適当にやってくれ。
trans-unit.target: Sorry, but I'm handing the Note off to you. Use it when you see fit.#ish

trans-unit.source: ちっ…しつこい連中だ。|仕方ない。あれを使うか。
trans-unit.target: Tch... Persistent bastards. There's no way around it. Guess I'll use that.

trans-unit.source: 追跡を振り切るためなら|ここは仕方ないだろう。
trans-unit.target: If it means throwing them off my scent then I've got no choice.

trans-unit.source: 犠牲者には申し訳ないが|仕方ない。
trans-unit.target: I feel bad for the sacrifices but there's no other way.

trans-unit.source: これほど簡単に…|あっけないものだ。
trans-unit.target: To think that it's so simple... How unsatisfying.

trans-unit.source: しつこく追ってこなければ|無事でいられたのにな。
trans-unit.target: They would have stayed safe if only they hadn't been dogged in their pursuit.

trans-unit.source: 私を恨まないでくれよ。|逮捕は願い下げなんだ。
trans-unit.target: Don't take it personally. I refuse to be arrested.

trans-unit.source: よし、少し動きやすく|なるだろう。
trans-unit.target: Good, now it should be somewhat easier to move around.

trans-unit.source: …こんなつまらん仕事は|めったにないな。
trans-unit.target: ...It's rare to get a job as boring as this one.

trans-unit.source: これでいい。|カメラに撮られては|危ないからな。
trans-unit.target: That should do it. It would be dangerous if I was caught on camera, after all.

trans-unit.source: ここはひとつ変装でも|するかな。
trans-unit.target: Maybe I should give a disguise a try.

trans-unit.source: 私だと気づかれなければいい。|難しく考える事はない。
trans-unit.target: As long as they don't realise it's me, then that's fine. I don't need to think too hard about it.

trans-unit.source: これならバレないだろうな。
trans-unit.target: This should keep them from finding out.

trans-unit.source: これはなんとも|古臭い手だな。
trans-unit.target: This is such an old-fashioned trick.

trans-unit.source: ちっ…連中いつから|こんな違法な手段を|使ってたんだ。
trans-unit.target: Tch... Since when did they start using illegal methods like this?

trans-unit.source: どうする…|見つけた以上、放置も|できないが。
trans-unit.target: What do I do... I've found it now, I can't exactly leave it alone.

trans-unit.source: おいおい、これを私に|使えというのか。
trans-unit.target: Hey now, you're telling me to use this thing?

trans-unit.source: 仕方ないな。預かっておくが|あまり期待するなよ。
trans-unit.target: I guess I've got no choice. I'll take it off your hands but don't expect too much, okay?

trans-unit.source: 正直、利用せずに|済ませたいものだが…
trans-unit.target: Honestly, I'd rather get through this without using it, but…

trans-unit.source: よし、周辺のカメラは|ほとんど落ちたな。
trans-unit.target: Alright, most of the cameras in this area have been dealt with.

trans-unit.source: これで警察は当分、復旧に|手を取られるはずだ。
trans-unit.target: That should keep the police occupied for a while, trying to restore them.

trans-unit.source: これで監視の心配はないが、|…いつまでもつかな。
trans-unit.target: Now there's no worry of being watched, but... For how long?#check

trans-unit.source: あいつには渡せない。|信用できないからな。
trans-unit.target: I can't give it to them. They can't be trusted.

trans-unit.source: あいつに任せるのは|危険だと思う。
trans-unit.target: I think it's dangerous to entrust it to them.

trans-unit.source: あいつに任せるくらいなら|自首した方が早い。
trans-unit.target: If I'm going to give it to them then I might as well hand myself in to the police already.

trans-unit.source: 誰にも気づかれず行くなら|地下鉄だろう。
trans-unit.target: If I'm going to move around without being noticed then I should take the subway.

trans-unit.source: バスか。途中は大丈夫だが、|降りる時に注意が必要だな。
trans-unit.target: A bus, huh. En route should be alright but I'll need to be cautious when I get off at the other end.

trans-unit.source: 水上バスか…|速いが身動きできないな。|油断しない方がいい。
trans-unit.target: A water-bus... It's quick but doesn't give me much freedom of movement. I better keep my guard up.

trans-unit.source: ヘリか…|さすがに安心と言いたいが…|いや、油断は禁物だ。
trans-unit.target: A helicopter... I'd love to say I can take it easy, but... No, I have to be on guard.

trans-unit.source: くそっ…こんなバカな！
trans-unit.target: Shit...! That's not possible!

trans-unit.source: 全部キラが|勝手にやった事なんだ！|俺達は被害者だ！
trans-unit.target: All of this is a trap set by Kira! We’re the victims here!

trans-unit.source: 違う…俺が…|俺が悪いんじゃない！
trans-unit.target: You’re wrong… I’m…|I’m not a bad person!

trans-unit.source: もう、俺は十分|ノートの番人したよな。|あとは頼む。
trans-unit.target: I’ve guarded this notebook for long enough. It’s your turn now.

trans-unit.source: ふぅ…やっとこのノートを|手放せる。
trans-unit.target: Phew… I’m finally letting go of this notebook.

trans-unit.source: 頼む、ノートはおまえが|うまく使ってくれよ。
trans-unit.target: I’m leaving the notebook to you. You’d better use it well.

trans-unit.source: くそっ…|やっぱり、ノートを使う事に|なっちまったか…
trans-unit.target: Damn it… So it’s really come down to this. I’ll have to use the notebook, huh…

trans-unit.source: ノートを使う以外に|手はないか…
trans-unit.target: I don’t have any choice but to use the notebook, huh…

trans-unit.source: 奴等から逃れるには|この手しかないか…
trans-unit.target: This is the only way to escape them, isn’t it…?

trans-unit.source: う…こんなに簡単に人が！
trans-unit.target: Ugh… It’s this easy to take a life?!

trans-unit.source: やっぱり、あまり使うのは|止めておこう。
trans-unit.target: I guess I really should stop using it so much.

trans-unit.source: し…仕方なかったんだ。|恨まないでくれよ。
trans-unit.target: There… There was no other way.|Don’t hate me for this, alright?

trans-unit.source: こんなものに見張られちゃ、|動けないからな。
trans-unit.target: I can't move as long as this thing is watching over me.

trans-unit.source: よし、これでしばらくは|大丈夫だろう。
trans-unit.target: Good, now I should be alright for a while.

trans-unit.source: これでいい。|だが、もしかすると|他にもまだあるのか？
trans-unit.target: This'll do. But what if there are still others?

trans-unit.source: 変装か…ばかばかしいが|やらないよりマシだ。
